about:
Unknown Arts operates as an owner-operated print shop in Burlington, Vermont. Founded by Phill, the business focuses on building relationships with other small local businesses to create custom printed garments for their customers, employees, and supporters.

The shop specializes in custom screen printing on a variety of apparel and accessories, including T-shirts, sweatshirts, tote bags, and other garments. Working from customer-supplied digital files, the team produces printed goods in vivid color, with access to a wide range of blank products for branding.

Unknown Arts primarily serves small local businesses, providing printed merchandise for their customers, employees, and supporters. The client base consists of area companies seeking branded apparel for promotional or internal use.

The company emphasizes a “Small. Local. Better.” philosophy, positioning its owner-operated model and relationship-driven approach as key differentiators in the local market.
